property_summary: For any caller and amount where the caller is the owner and c.sendTo is invoked sending ETH to a callee that REVERTS on receiving funds, the reference C always reverts (call fails) while the mutant may return successfully; thus assert that calling sendTo to a reverting recipient always reverts for owner calls.
change_summary: Replace transfer with low-level call but drop the require on the call result so failing sends no longer revert (non-reverting behavior differs).
